comment.text: MEF2B K4 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Lymphoid neoplasms. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting MEF2B residue K4 have been observed in lymphoid neoplasms. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
